Add routes.ts:16 importing @orchestra/core/host and core/package.json:178 mapping ./host to ./src/host.ts. Propagate ranges to edge and source/excerpt manifests.
Narrow boundary to S1 Server -> S1 Core and the already traced application composition S5->S3 (E02/E03). Remove the unsupported assertion that E04 demonstrates contributions originating in S4.
